name: pwnfactor
description: Agentic engineering harness: a feature lifecycle spine (Frame -> Plan -> Build -> Verify -> Integrate), a risk-routed multi-agent review panel (code-review + simplifier + security Claude subagents plus optional Codex cross-model review), a deliberate subagent-orchestration playbook for the build loop, a ground-truth validation gate, and a read-only pre-prod security sweep, and system cards (a versioned per-subsystem decision layer with a staleness checker, so sessions stop re-deriving past decisions). Token-efficient docs, safety-rail aware, solo-mode friendly. Use its skills as /pwnfactor:run, /pwnfactor:gg, /pwnfactor:validate, /pwnfactor:swarm, /pwnfactor:sweep, /pwnfactor:cards, /pwnfactor:help.
